title: fix(pm): a ceiling claim's citation is read inside its model slot; RUNNER's security-fix effort follows the pm-dispatch rule
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuYMxVr4whKU7SgYTUvvzVkx)_

Part of #35270

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；派发认领里「最贵档」的理由只认写在档位那一格里的，测试清单说明里安全修复的力度改成跟派发规则一致。
- 为什么做：属于车队派发力度整理（替力度规则那张卡收尾两处小尾巴）；此前力度格里的理由会被误当成档位理由放行，清单说明还写着一律最高力度。
- 出错会怎样：只影响车队自己的认领检查与说明文字；写错最多误拦或误放一条认领，可直接撤回本次改动。
- 要你做什么：无

## What changes

- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`: `readContainerModelLine` reads the `MANDATORY` / `reason:` citation only inside the `model:` slot, from the `model:` key to the next `effort:` key or to the end of the line. Before, it matched anywhere on the `Container & model:` line, so an `effort: xhigh, reason: ...` citation satisfied the ceiling-tier check by accident (contract-review nit N1, release comment 7027271918). The tier token and every correctly written claim read as before. The jsdoc states the rule.
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`: three cases. Two negatives: a citation only in the effort slot is refused, for `reason:` and for `MANDATORY`. One positive twin: a citation inside the model slot with commas and parentheses still reads with an effort slot after it.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` line 94: a runner's security fix is no longer dispatched "at `xhigh`". It follows the pm-dispatch security effort rule and names `references/execution-duties.md`: high-severity built at `high` with one read-only `xhigh` diff review, medium-severity at `high`, anything else by difficulty (ruling record 7024443457, decision 一 A).

## Tests

- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` at `366b52cf2` (the same commit before it was moved onto `main` at `e3e202a97` as `f64915ce5`): exit 0, fast tier 2252 cases pass (2249 + 3).
- Red on the old code: the three predicates run against the HEAD blob of the old reader answer a=false, b=false, c=true (both negatives red, the twin green); against the new reader, all true.

## Acceptance notes

- N5/N6 of the release comment: gone. The ceiling table was re-based to bytes by #35712 and no longer carries those row comments.
- Not in this PR: items 1 and 2 of the release comment (measurement runs, the maintainer's word) and nit N4.
- Landing tier: Tier H. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` is on the governed register, so this PR waits for the governed approver.
- No changeset: `scripts/pm/**` and `docs/qa/**` do not ship in a package (`skip-changeset`).

## Verification

- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 69 commands at `366b52cf2`, the same commit on its earlier base; all ran, all exit 0 after the two exit-3 prerequisite builds (verify lock VERDICT command-exit 0); `--ran`: 68 families accounted for, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `overlap-check`: VERDICT clean exit 0.

Read first: the slot cut in `readContainerModelLine` (three added lines), then the three new self-test cases.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test --fast` prints the three new case titles as passing.
